summary: ClassKit reports assignable app content and student progress to Apple's Schoolwork app, which runs only inside Apple's education service. BifrOSt has no Schoolwork counterpart and no education progress service, so there is nothing to match.

features.apple: ClassKit Environment Entitlement, Enabling ClassKit in your app
features.note: entitlement tied to the Schoolwork service
describes app content to Schoolwork, not a general API
records student progress for teacher dashboards
views depend on the Schoolwork assignment flow
store is ClassKit-owned, no local equivalent
